title: Oven Roasted Dutch Lamb Skewers
description: A traditional Dutch dish featuring lamb skewers marinated in a mix of olive oil, garlic, and red wine jelly, then roasted to perfection in a robata grill, served with a side of crusty bread and a fresh salad. This recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters looking to try a new and exciting flavor combination.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine jelly, garlic, salt, black pepper, and rosemary.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the robata grill and roast for 15 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush the lamb with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb skewers hot, garnished with additional rosemary if desired.
